payload.explanation: Use Omarchy's chosen-agent setting so the normal Agent shortcut starts the preferred supported agent.

steps: Confirm Codex is installed or review Omarchy's installation prompt before proceeding.
Use Omarchy's default-agent selector to choose Codex. The command omarchy default agent codex can install or launch the selected agent; it is not a read-only probe.
Read omarchy default agent with no arguments to check the selected label, then test the Agent shortcut.

payload.effects: Changes the default agent selected by Omarchy, not the model or settings inside other agents.
payload.rollback: Select the previously preferred supported agent using Omarchy's default-agent selector.
payload.validation_plan: Preserve the previous setting, apply only after approval, then perform the final check in the procedure on the actual system.

activation.details: Apply the setting and perform its documented local check; this record does not execute it.
